<script>
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    const detailsElements = document.querySelectorAll("details");

    detailsElements.forEach(details => {
      details.addEventListener("toggle", function() {
        const content = this.querySelector("ul");
        if (this.open) {
          content.style.maxHeight = content.scrollHeight + "px";
        } else {
          content.style.maxHeight = content.scrollHeight + "px"; // Set to scrollHeight to trigger transition
          setTimeout(() => {
            content.style.maxHeight = "0";
          }, 10); // Delay to allow transition to take effect
        }
      });

      // Initialize max-height for already open details
      if (details.open) {
        const content = details.querySelector("ul");
        content.style.maxHeight = content.scrollHeight + "px";
      }
    });
  });
</script>
